title: The Judgment of the Nations in the Valley of Jehoshaphat
description: The Lord announces that he will restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem and gather all nations to the Valley of Jehoshaphat to judge them. Tyre, Sidon, Philistia, Egypt, and Edom are accused of violence against Israel, for scattering the people, dividing the land, and selling the children of Judah. The Lord calls for holy war: plowshares are beaten into swords, sickles are raised, and winepresses are trodden, for evil is great. On the day of judgment the sun and moon grow dark while the Lord roars from Zion. He is a refuge for his people, and the land will flow with wine and milk, while a spring flows out from the house of the Lord.
